These techniques are inconsistent with a legitimate SQL lineage visualization tool and are characteristic of malware attempting to hide credential theft, data exfiltration, or remote code execution capabilities. The disconnect between the benign advertised functionality and the suspicious code structure warrants a high-risk classification.
